# Independent preparation review: phased checked formals

Read-only review by `/root/isometry_cli_tests`, 2026-10-05 UTC. The frozen phased contract was authored by `/root/review_isometry_adapter`; this reviewer did not author it. The reviewer authored earlier next-unit analysis and reviewed the earlier candidate, which is disclosed separately from this independent review of the newly concrete contract. This is preparation review, not implementation/build validation or formal mathematics.

## Verdict and seven-file boundary

The contract is a substantive bounded next unit: one ordered formal judgment owns prefix Natural/Basis keys, checked ordinary operation bases, optional finite Meaning payloads and the canonical Apply/Adjoint/Controlled mask, and its actual facts move into both real consumers. It removes declaration-policy duplication rather than adding an access-only helper. No blocking contract defect was found in the inspected current paths. The existing immutable indexed sized projection is a viable key/type input; this route need not reconstruct an original whole-body Index. It does not complete direct-original generic body checking or converge the two accepted profiles.

The explicit seven production files are sufficient: new frontend/formals.rs plus frontend/mod.rs, compile/operations.rs, sized/check.rs, sized/linear.rs, sized/ast.rs and sized/parser.rs. Resolver/source collection/grammar/AST and Lean/native rules need not change. Source Type/Access and BinderKey remain authoritative representations. Profile callbacks retain their existing support limits and public diagnostics. The new private mask is a generic assumption, not executable capability evidence or a verified handle.

Implementation review must confirm the shared helper actually receives every original static ordinal; complete static/runtime/requirement cardinality checks and source/projected kind plus actual Table binder-category/key assertions cannot be replaced by zip-prefix traversal or spelling lookup. Source/projection metadata equality may assert association, never reconstruct a binder. The sized parameter references already carry actual keys produced by the original Index. Access must use only the actual resolved local key installed as this declaration's operation; neither a global nor the finite compatibility static candidate may rescue it.

Finite callbacks must keep signature/profile/resolution/name checks first, then ordinary basis/finite width, Meaning basis-tree equality and charge-before-matrix-copy, then access. Clone only the small actual BinderKey before a callback mutably borrows Compiler if required by Rust borrowing; no lifetime trick, cached Project judgment or copied whole AST is needed. Move checked basis/Meaning/mask into the existing Operation, preserving Node::Abstract identity/depth/nodes/abstract_value.

Sized checking must keep all-Nat premises/feasibility first, shared ordered kinds next, access next, then runtime name/type/bind, result, and all generic body/effect checks. Do not remove its every-function source-order loop, DefId→module→ast_index association, private/unused checking, both static arms or zero-fold checking. Store each shared ordinary Op basis with exactly one existing Q wrapper; two wrappers or an unwrapped basis change the actual operation type.

The borrowed kind environment must keep the full Parameter availability/substitution-capacity scan before Natural normalization. During Natural normalization gate each actual local key against the shared preceding-Nat set at the existing recursive Name lookup; do not pre-scan Natural occurrences. Thread the optional allowed view through all recursive paths, retaining at() diagnostic frames, left/right order, overflow/subtraction proofs and bounded capacity accounting. Keep unrestricted ordinary callers via the old wrapper. Preserve prefix Basis substitution availability/storage checks. Borrow unchanged full premise Context, rather than cloning Scope/owners/maps/counters or materializing a prefix map.

The mechanical Access enum conversion must cover declaration grants, all body accesses, callee requirements and both existing all-access provider constructors. Use one enum-to-slot mapping [Apply,Adjoint,Controlled]. Preserve existing missing-access spelling and profile-specific spans. All-three-true provider masks remain all-three-true; the change must not strengthen a formal's initially false mask or grant inverse/control from unitarity/Meaning.

## Independent audit of the actual40 baseline

All forty observation JSON records were read against their raw stdout/stderr hashes, complete client statuses, pre-execv native journals/hashes and summary rows. All JSON-presentation records were decoded from actual raw stdout and matched their retained API objects. The result is **6 success,34 source/semantic refusal,46 pre-execv forwarded attempt rows**, with no capture timeout/error/output cap. Those rows are not independently observed native starts/exits; no executable was run by this reviewer. The forty sources/manifests and outputs remain unchanged.

Representative original diagnostic priorities remain concrete:

| Case | Finite Project | Selected source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mixed Basis/Natural | unsupported Nat at93..94 | unavailable B at125..126 before nonlinear n*n |
| Natural-only order | unsupported Nat at93..94 | nonlinear n*n at119..122 before later k |
| Duplicate Apply | capability on U151..152 | access on keyword Apply145..150 |
| Static/runtime collision | ownership U106..107 | unknown access keyword Apply146..151 |
| Unused missing Apply | capability U130..131,one forwarded attempt per presentation | access U(q)130..134,zero attempts |
| Forward Nat/Basis | actual finite Bits/Named type barriers | unknown n110..111 or unavailable A105..106 |

The selected access span correction in phased-contract-01 is accurate: AccessConstraint.span covers the keyword, not the full constraint. Shared checking must preserve the actual text/JSON order, spans and native attempt argv/count. The valid-dependent-basis positive reaches the selected real ordered kind path; its finite rejection is only the earlier unsupported profile, and cannot validate finite downstream kind judgment.

MeaningEvidence's generic contract tests are secondary evidence; they do not substitute for the actual finite abstract formal consumer moving its checked optional matrix. Existing operation_parameters receipt and wrong phase/tree cases exercise that path directly. Unsupported selected Meaning refinements remain projection refusals, not downstream shared formal successes.

## Direct selected per-slot coverage gap

The forty baseline cases grant/duplicate Apply and have a wrong-kind Controlled target; they have no valid formal Adjoint or valid Controlled body. Among the selected/sized/basis tests inspected above, no direct `requires Adjoint(U){adjoint(U,q)}` formal control was found. Existing finite tests cover the shared canonical slots, and sized forwarding covers Controlled; neither alone demonstrates every selected mask consumption slot. This is a verification gap, not a policy change or blocker on ordinary factoring.

If root adds bounded real-consumer controls, retain the original40 packet and make the new sources/logs a separate before/after packet. Small private generic f plus ordinary public main()->Unit is sufficient: positive f[U:Op<Bit>] with Adjoint(U) and body adjoint(U,q), negative same body with only Apply(U); positive f(c,q) with Controlled(U) and body controlled(U)(c,q), negative with only Apply(U); duplicate Adjoint(U) and duplicate Controlled(U) each reject their second keyword/name under existing profile spans. These are prospective existing-grammar translations, not parsed/executed facts or new permission. Freeze first actual diagnostics before implementation if these controls are chosen. No source was created by this review.

This scope preserves edition2026, current accepted boundaries, ordinary two QLV1 guarantees and pending QS/PR/RS/EXACT/general source-preservation obligations. It provides no Issue close credit, general frontend/Meaning completion or release-ready claim. Some initial broad/guessed read commands were truncated or found nonexistent module names; the actual selected paths and this audit's limits are identified in the companion subset map.
